TMFOXR.name: TrackMania Forever OpenXR
TMFOXR.author: jiink
TMFOXR.description: Native stereoscopic OpenXR rendering and headset tracking for TrackMania United Forever. Settings are stored in Documents\TrackMania\TMFOXR.ini.

7.0.0.changelog:
- Frustum culling fix. It's not perfect, but now you can look around and see everything around you.
- Now you can see the thingies that connect your stadium car's wheels to the body.
- Improved performance. It's nothing impressive, but noticeably better than before.
- In-VR settings menu. By default, you can press F10 to open/close it. You will probably want to use your mouse to control it.
- Support for TrackMania ModLoader
- Fixed weird stuff going on with dual-GPU laptops.

Only tested on Windows 10 with Quest 3 using Virtual Desktop and VDXR OpenXR runtime.

This works with TrackMania Nations Forever and TrackMania United Forever.

Release notes: https://github.com/jiink/TrackManiaForeverOpenXR/releases/tag/v7

8.0.0.changelog:
- Added new VR settings: scaling slider, and whether or not to recenter if your head moves too far from the car
- Fixed verbose logging not being followed very well

Only tested on Windows 10 with Quest 3 using Virtual Desktop and VDXR OpenXR runtime.

This works with TrackMania Nations Forever and TrackMania United Forever.

Release notes: https://github.com/jiink/TrackManiaForeverOpenXR/releases/tag/v8

9.0.0.changelog:
What's Changed:

- Compatibility with the TM Vibrant Shaders mod thanks to @wial663 and @cheatoskar

Note:
If you want to play these two mods together, I think you'll need to use the TrackMania ModLoader (TMLoader) installation method. I couldnt' get it to work with the manual installation method
